sn52.4:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno sākete viharanti kaṇṭakīvane.
sn52.4:1.2: atha kho āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhitā yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā anuruddhena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
sn52.4:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca:
sn52.4:1.4: “sekhena āvuso, anuruddha, bhikkhunā katame dhammā upasampajja vihātabbā”ti.
sn52.4:2.1: sekhena āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbā.
sn52.4:2.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.4:2.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.4:2.7: sekhena āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbāti.
